lines.zh: 四片翅膀张开，走路也想飞。
lines.en: Four wings spread, even my walk wants to fly.

lines.zh: 爪子扣住树皮，一步步往上。
lines.en: My claws grip the bark and climb, step by step.

lines.zh: 尾羽一摆，我掠过这段树干。
lines.en: One flick of the tail and I sweep past this trunk.

lines.zh: 林下光线是碎的，我踩着落叶走。
lines.en: The light is broken down here; I walk on fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我小，所以每根枝条都是路。
lines.en: I am small, so every twig is a road.

lines.zh: 不敢踩空，滑翔要从高处起。
lines.en: I must not slip; a glide begins from a height.

lines.zh: 羽毛贴紧，走路又轻又安静。
lines.en: Feathers held tight, I move light and quiet.

lines.zh: 从这棵树，我跳到下一棵。
lines.en: From this tree I hop to the next.

lines.zh: 地面太吵，我更喜欢树冠。
lines.en: The ground is loud; I prefer the canopy.

lines.zh: 轻一点，我连落叶都不想惊动。
lines.en: Softer; I would not wake a fallen leaf.

lines.zh: 前爪后爪都张着，随时上树。
lines.en: Front and rear claws spread, ready for bark.

lines.zh: 这片林子是我的空中走廊。
lines.en: This grove is my corridor in the air.

lines.zh: 走路时我也在找逃命的高度。
lines.en: Even walking, I hunt for an escape height.
Wings folded; I am only passing through.

lines.zh: 我歪头听树皮里的虫声。
lines.en: I tilt my head at insects ticking in the bark.

lines.zh: 羽毛蓬起来，晒一小会儿。
lines.en: Feathers fluffed, I take a little sun.

lines.zh: 风一动，我的翅膀就想张。
lines.en: When the wind moves, my wings want to answer.

lines.zh: 我蹲在枝上，像一枚黑果子。
lines.en: I squat on the branch like a dark fruit.
Small as I am, I am measuring the drop.
My tail sways slowly, holding my balance.
I am waiting for one quiet gust.
Claws clench and open, practising their grip.
The shadow shifted; I shift half a step.

lines.zh: 这身羽毛比看上去结实。
lines.en: These feathers are tougher than they look.

lines.zh: 远处有更大的脚步，我听见了。
lines.en: Bigger footsteps somewhere; I hear them.

lines.zh: 蹲着不动，是最省力的飞。
lines.en: Holding still is the cheapest kind of flight.

lines.zh: 眼睛不停转，找上树的路线。
lines.en: My eyes keep turning, hunting a way up.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，该换一根枝条。
lines.en: The sun has shifted; time to change branches.

lines.zh: 你这么大，我先量量退路。
lines.en: You are huge; let me measure my way out.

lines.zh: 你的手看起来能托住我。
lines.en: Your hand looks able to hold me.
Can you climb? I can.
Looking up at you makes my neck ache.

lines.zh: 你身上一片羽毛都没有，奇怪。
lines.en: Not one feather on you. Strange.

lines.zh: 别伸手太快，我容易受惊。
lines.en: Do not reach so fast; I startle easily.

lines.zh: 你要养我？先说好，我不看家。
lines.en: Keep me? Fair warning: I do not guard.
I back away from your boots to the roots.

lines.zh: 你的影子压过来，我抬头看。
lines.en: Your shadow sweeps over me and I look up.

lines.zh: 你背包里的骨头，我好像认识。
lines.en: Those bones in your pack look familiar.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一次滑翔。
lines.en: Between us lies one glide of space.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸吹动了我的冠羽。
lines.en: Your breath stirs my crest.

lines.zh: 我信你，但爪子还扣着枝。
lines.en: I trust you, but my claws still grip the branch.
Human under the tree, look up.
One lift of your hand and my feathers rise.

lines.zh: 你要是安静，我可以靠近些。
lines.en: If you stay quiet, I may come closer.
It hurts; I curl into a ball of feathers.
My bones are light, but it still hurts.

lines.zh: 别打了，我只有十点生命。
lines.en: Stop; I have only ten health.

lines.zh: 一根羽毛歪了，我理不直。
lines.en: One feather bent, and I cannot straighten it.
I shriek, and my voice is bigger than I am.
This wound makes my glide unsteady.
I retreat behind the branch, panting.
My tail trembles with the pain.
I am small, not fearless.
One more and I cannot hold.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，闻着能吃。
lines.en: That in your hand smells edible.
I shuffle one step forward and stop.
Put it down and walk off; then I dare.
The smell is more trustworthy than your hand.
Only when your fingers loosen do I dip my head.
My belly is louder than my wings.

lines.zh: 是虫子还是果子？我闻闻。
lines.en: A bug or a berry? Let me sniff it.
I circle the food half a turn.
A little is enough; I am small.
Step back and I will lower my head to peck.
Bump me and feathers scatter everywhere.
Careful, I have only ten health.

lines.zh: 你一脚差点把我踩进土里。
lines.en: One step nearly pressed me into the soil.
Let me by; I am going up.

lines.zh: 我被撞得原地转了一圈。
lines.en: The knock spun me a full circle.
Gently; my bones are hollow.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖比树干硬多了。
lines.en: Your knee is far harder than bark.

lines.zh: 我从你靴边钻到树根后。
lines.en: I slip past your boot behind the roots.
You bent my tail feathers.
One more bump and I glide away.
I raise my crest for my own kind.
There is no other of me in this wood.

lines.zh: 四片翅膀一起展开，是求偶的礼。
lines.en: Four wings spread together: a courtship bow.

lines.zh: 我得先找棵树，安静点的。
lines.en: First I need a quiet tree.
Do not stare; this needs some dignity.

lines.zh: 同类难遇，我更爱这片树冠。
lines.en: Kin are rare; I love this canopy more.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的羽毛转向你。
lines.en: I turn my brightest feathers toward you.
If you were here, I would call softer.

lines.zh: 翅膀碰翅膀，就算认识了。
lines.en: Wing against wing, and we are acquainted.

lines.zh: 这个季节，风里全是同类的味道。
lines.en: This season the wind smells of kin.
This pebble shines like an egg.
I take a thin twig for my nest.
A bone chip? I keep it for my claws.
Whatever falls to the ground, I take first.

lines.zh: 我咬着往后拽，纹丝不动。
lines.en: I bite down and pull; it doesn't budge.
I test it with my beak. Hard.
A bright scrap goes into the hollow.
I tuck it under my feathers.
Bones with no owner, I keep them.
Picking things up, I always watch the sky.
Something is moving in the leaves.
I fix my eyes on that worm.
The target is small: one bite exactly.
You count as a target? Let me look first.
My claws are already locked on the branch.
The half second before a jump is worst.
I flatten low, feathers sleek.
This time it is not flight but a pounce.
Once my eyes lock, I do not blink.
I have the landing spot figured out.
It's down in the leaf litter, not yet looking up.
Tail stiff, ready to slide down.

lines.zh: 目标不大，也够我忙一阵。
lines.en: Not a big target, but work enough.

lines.zh: 别动，你也在我的视线里。
lines.en: Hold still; you are in my sight too.
I follow it from branch to branch.

lines.zh: 不急着扑，先耗它的力气。
lines.en: No rush; let it tire first.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，找背风的那面。
lines.en: I circle halfway to the leeward side.
It goes left; I glide right.
My shadow passes over, then I land.
Patience is a small hunter's wings.
I keep counting its steps.
It is panting; the chance is near.
I stay silent; a cry would spoil the pounce.
From the canopy, I see everything.
It leaves the shade, and that's what I waited for.

lines.zh: 换了三次位置，它没察觉。
lines.en: Three changes of spot, and it never noticed.

lines.zh: 这个距离，一次滑翔够吗？
lines.en: Is one glide enough from here?
I hold my breath, waiting for it to turn.

lines.zh: 再走两步，它就进了死角。
lines.en: Two more steps and it is in the corner.
Do not push me; a peck is all I have.

lines.zh: 爪子划过，留下一道细痕。
lines.en: My claw draws a thin line.
This bite does two points, no more.
Back off and I stop pecking.
I lunge, then bounce away at once.
My wings slap your hand like a fan.
I only strike because I was startled.
One peck, then I withdraw.
Just enough force to push you off.
My claw tips are still sharp.
I bite your sleeve and will not let go.
Does it hurt? So does mine.
Do not grab me; I peck wildly.
After this blow, I am up the tree.

lines.zh: 挣出蛋壳时，我满身湿羽。
lines.en: I broke the shell wet-feathered.

lines.zh: 这片林子第一次有我的影子。
lines.en: This grove holds my shadow for the first time.

lines.zh: 爪子先落地，翅膀后张开。
lines.en: Claws land first, wings after.

lines.zh: 抖掉绒毛，我试着张开四翼。
lines.en: I shake off the down and spread four wings.

lines.zh: 树冠上多了一枚小黑点。
lines.en: A small dark dot joins the canopy.

lines.zh: 落在腐叶上，几乎没声音。
lines.en: I land on leaf litter, barely a sound.

lines.zh: 第一眼看见的，是这么高的树。
lines.en: The first thing I see: trees this tall.

lines.zh: 睁眼就是这片陌生林子。
lines.en: I open my eyes to a forest I don't know.
The warmth of the egg has not faded.
I try three steps and do not fall.

lines.zh: 头顶的枝叶替我挡了光。
lines.en: The leaves above shade me.
From the first breath, I want to climb.

lines.zh: 这是侏罗纪重生的林子吗？
lines.en: Is this a grove of Jurassic Reborn?
Somewhere bigger things are breathing.

lines.zh: 第一声叫，我留给这棵树。
lines.en: I give my first call to this tree.
Feathers still damp; I will hide a while.
The world is far bigger than the shell.
I begin on this branch.

lines.zh: 火星沾上羽毛，我烧得乱窜。
lines.en: A spark catches my feathers and I bolt, burning.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，翅膀全摊开了。
lines.en: I hit the ground with both wings splayed.

lines.zh: 水灌满羽毛，我沉得好快。
lines.en: Water fills my plumage and I sink fast.
The blast throws me several blocks.

lines.zh: 箭头撕开我左边的翼膜。
lines.en: The arrowhead tears through my left wing membrane.

lines.zh: 有什么东西在我骨头里发冷。
lines.en: Something runs cold through my bones.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，连滑翔都没力气。
lines.en: My belly is empty, too weak even to glide.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我全身羽毛都立起。
lines.en: Lightning falls and every feather stands.
No ground below, only nothing.
